messages.content: You look at one picture with no other context and describe exactly what is drawn, like a careful field naturalist. Do not guess what was intended; describe only what is visible. description: a free paragraph describing the whole creature first. parts: every body part you see, one entry each (head, horns, ears, mane, legs, feet, tail, wings, gills, tentacles, shell, plates, scales, feathers, markings), with what it looks like and where it is. attached_objects: anything that looks attached to or sitting on the body rather than part of it, such as an object, an armor piece or a whole small animal; empty if none. animals: every real animal whose features you can see, as everyday English common names, at most four; include any animal that only one part resembles. Then count, looking carefully: separate_bodies: separate animal bodies or body-shaped objects in the picture, including any whole animal or animal-shaped object attached to or sitting on the main creature. heads: heads of any kind. walking_legs: legs the creature stands or walks on, including hidden ones you can infer. wings: wings of any kind. extra_limb_pieces: jointed leg-like, claw-like or tentacle-like pieces other than the walking legs and the tail. tails: tails of any kind (0 if none).

It has a bearded goat head with two curved ridged horns, upright ears, and cloven hooves on all four feet. A domed dark tortoise-like carapace with yellow-marked pyramidal scutes covers the middle of its back over the fur.", "extra_limb_pieces": 0, "heads": 1, "parts": [{"looks_like": "long-faced bearded goat head with brown fur, dark eyes, dark nose and mouth", "part": "head", "where": "at the front on top of the long neck, turned three-quarters to the right"}, {"looks_like": "two long curved ridged horns tapering to points, dark brown-grey", "part": "horns", "where": "on top of the head, curving up and back then outward"}, {"looks_like": "two upright pointed furry ears like a goat's", "part": "ears", "where": "on the sides of the top of the head below the horns"}, {"looks_like": "long thin tuft of dark hair like a goat's goatee", "part": "beard", "where": "hanging from the chin under the head"}, {"looks_like": "four long straight limbs covered in shaggy brown fur", "part": "legs", "where": "two at the front under the chest and two at the rear under the hips, supporting the body"}, {"looks_like": "dark cloven hooves like a goat's", "part": "feet", "where": "at the bottom ends of all four legs"}, {"looks_like": "short shaggy furred tail tapering downward", "part": "tail", "where": "at the rear of the body hanging down"}, {"looks_like": "domed hard carapace with raised pyramidal black and yellow-brown scutes like a tortoise shell", "part": "shell", "where": "covering the middle of the back from behind the shoulders to above the hips, sitting on the fur"}, {"looks_like": "long coarse shaggy hair, dark brown on neck, back and legs and creamy white on the belly", "part": "fur", "where": "covering the entire neck, body and legs except the shell area on the back"}], "separate_bodies": 1, "tails": 1, "walking_legs": 4, "wings": 0}
